facts.fact: The DGAPE ReDiaspora page describes diaspora voter registration via the Portal Consular with APIs to insert requests into the Base de Dados do Recenseamento Eleitoral (BDRE) and integration with the Sistema Integrado de Gestão Eleitoral (SIGE).

The DGAPE ReDiaspora page says the system interoperates with the SNIAC database and registers voters automatically when they request a passport or national ID card (CNI), using their data if not already registered.
